data.one_liner: A reorderable and sortable wrap widget written in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SortableWrap widget that allows users to rearrange child widgets using drag and drop interactions. It supports spacing, run spacing, and long-press to drag functionality across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need a Wrap layout where children can be reordered by dragging.
You want a pure Dart solution supporting mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You need standard linear reordering (use ReorderableListView instead).
You require complex grid animations not supported by Wrap layouts.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows.
Simple API similar to standard Wrap widgets.
weaknesses: Limited feature documentation outside of basic reordering.
No built-in state management for the underlying data array.
